label: First Vatican Council, Dei Filius Ch. 3…… supports Whatever is GOD_4 and has the classical… (3)
note: Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 1: God revealing cannot deceive (nec fallere). Reading 'not deceiving' as asserting only what one holds as known, and extending it from revealing to all asserting by a God with the classical attributes, is the analyst's; the council does not state it in these terms.
